subject: QBR playbook scrub + escalation paths for account-level forecasts
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@zenithsystems.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR playbook scrub + escalation paths for account-level forecasts

Team / Acme folks —

As we gear up for the QBR (week of May 1), I want to run a short playbook scrub focused on two things: 1) account-by-account forecast consolidation and 2) clear escalation paths when a forecast delta >20% emerges between field and finance.

Immediate asks:
- Internal owners: fill the attached QBR_account_playbook_template.xlsx for your accounts by EOD Friday (Apr 20). Use the "forecast delta" column to call out where your number differs materially from SFDC target and add a 1-line reason.
- Acme / Zenith: please confirm any procurement/contract timing that would materially shift close dates this quarter (upload to the Drive link).
- Ops: Monica, can you run a consolidated pivot (per-region, ARR, probability) and share the CSV so I can present a single slide to the execs?

Escalation rules (proposed, please comment):
- Delta 0-10%: field owner notes + no escalation.
- Delta 10-20%: make a mitigation plan (2 bullets) and loop in sales ops.
- Delta >20% or movement off the funnel (deal recycling/contract hold): immediate escalation to me + Markus + Finance.

I've attached a blank playbook template and a previous Acme gap analysis to help with formatting.

Proposed QBR agenda snippet for this section (10 min):
- Two-slide account rollup (Monica)
- Three spotlight accounts: Acme, Zenith, and Orion — field owner quick synopsis + ask (Markus to chair)
- Risk & mitigation handoff (Karthik)

Thanks — I want this tight so exec time is focused on decisions.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
(t) +1 415-555-0132
[tessa.morgan@redwood.ai]

Attachments: QBR_account_playbook_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_gap_analysis.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: QBR playbook scrub + escalation paths for account-level forecasts

Thanks Tessa — noted. I'm attaching my account summaries for the three spotlight accounts (short notes per account + updated commit probability). Two quick notes on Acme:
- Sales cycle: legal is the current gating item (LOE for Redwood Private review). Targeting signature by 4/28 but Procurement may ask for a two-week extension.
- Forecast delta: field has +18% vs SFDC target due to upsell line. I'm adding a mitigation bullet in the template.

I'll coordinate with Laura to ensure the demo env is ready for the exec walkthrough.

-Markus
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Tessa — noted. Two operational clarifications from my side:
1) For "delta >20%" escalations, do we want an automated alert from SFDC (deal size >$250k) to trigger the pager to Ops (Monica + me) *and* an immediate calendar hold for a 15-min sync? I can get the trigger in place but need sign-off.
2) Monica: please include both "field target" and "finance target" columns in the consolidated CSV; we need to make the variance calculation explicit in the slide so execs don't ask later.

I'll draft the short escalation template (1-slide remediation + owner + due date) and circulate by EOD.

- Karthik
Director, Revenue Ops

Attached is the consolidated_forecast_2028Q2.csv and a one-slide export (PDF) that I propose we use for the QBR. Highlights:
- Combined ARR (spotlight set) = $4.2M.
- Net movement vs SFDC targets: +9% (driven by upsell in Acme and Zenith).
- Three deals flagged >20% variance: Acme (18% up but legal risk), Orion (+24% due to extended PO timing), Nimbus (+32% due to delayed procurement).

I've included a column "escalation_required" with values yes/no and a recommended owner (Markus/Karthik/Tessa). Let me know if the format works and I'll push to the shared Drive folder.

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick decisions/next steps: 
- Monica: push the CSV + slide to the Drive folder and I'll lock the exec slide deck by Apr 24 COB.
- Karthik: please implement the SFDC alert for >$250k deals and ensure the 15-min calendar hold is auto-created for any "escalation_required = yes" rows.
- Markus: you will prepare the Acme spotlight (5 min) but coordinate closely with Jordan on the legal note — add a contingency slide if signature slips to mid-May.
- Laura: prep the demo env checklist; we'll do a dry run on Apr 27 (invite to follow).

Acme / Jordan — thank you for the heads up on legal. If you can surface the SOW change language by EOD Friday we will slot a contingency calculation into the QBR so the execs can see upside/downside.

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for the QBR prep dry run (Apr 27) and add a 10-min pre-read section.

Best,
Tessa
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
